notes.title: SpellForce 3: Fallen God and Free Multiplayer Version Versus now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10407636/1a09c094820180aab1b66788855e7050b2deb9e5.png[/img]

[b]SpellForce 3: Fallen God and Free Multiplayer Version Versus now available![/b]
[b]SpellForce Free: New SpellForce Versus Lets You Play Ranked Multiplayer Matches For Free[/b]

Vienna, Austria / Munich, Germany, November 3rd, 2020 – The SpellForce-Franchise gets two new additions today. Not only is the second stand-alone expansion, Fallen God out now, but also the all new SpellForce 3: Versus Edition. SpellForce 3: Versus is a Free-to-play version of SpellForce 3, allowing players to participate in the newly introduced ranked multiplayer as well as play in a skirmish against AI opponents. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154040/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416260/

In SpellForce 3: Versus, you are able to play either Humans, Orcs and Elves - and your faction is randomly chosen for you when you start the game for the first - once an Orc, always an Orc! While fighting against other users of SpellForce 3: Versus, you can also face players from the expansions Fallen God and Soul Harvest - there will be just one big SpellForce 3 player base. SpellForce 3: Versus will have NO microtransactions, NO advertisement or any other common Free-to-play mechanic. You can play Versus absolutely free of charge, only if you want to have access to the singleplayer campaigns from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/311290/]SpellForce 3[/url] and its stand-alone expansions [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/817540/]Soul Harvest[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154040/]Fallen God[/url], you'll have to buy them. Check out this handy overview, to see which version features what: 
                
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/f957572887b8e28ede0b34c5c3f89f80939055e6.jpg[/img]

Additionally, there is a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1460150/]“SpellForce 3: Versus Edition - Full PvP Upgrade”[/url] DLC available, allowing you to access each of the six different SpellForce-factions in your Versus Edition: Humans, Orcs, Dwarves, Dark Elves, Trolls and Elves. This package is available for $ 14.99/ € 14.99 € / £ 12.99. 

Check out the action-packed SpellForce 3: Versus Trailer: 
YouTube: https://youtu.be/f0ZiQV4XqMI

[h2]About SpellForce 3: Versus Edition[/h2]
The SpellForce 3: Versus Edition gives you the chance to enter the battlefields of Eo for free, letting you test your RTS skills against AI opponents or even other human players.

[b]Skirmish or 1-on-1 Multiplayer[/b]
You can choose whether you want to take on AI enemies in a Skirmish battle, or go head-to-head with other human players of SpellForce 3 in both Ranked and Unranked PVP matches. On top of it all you can also check out the single-player scenario ‘Old Haalâyash’ to get a glimpse of what the lavishly created single-player campaigns of SpellForce 3 and its stand-alone expansions have to offer.

[b]Multiplayer Races: Orcs, Humans and Elves [/b]
You will be randomly assigned a faction, giving you a chance to try out either playing as Orcs, Humans or Elves.

Each faction has its own strengths and traits, so you’ll need to develop your strategy to make the most of your warriors and workers. And because the faction is randomly assigned every time you play, you’ll have to think fast in order to secure victory.

[b]Upgrade to unlock more excitement[/b]
This is just a taste of the challenge and fun that SpellForce 3’s RTS matches have to offer. When you are hungry for more, the full versions of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/311290/]SpellForce 3[/url] and its stand-alone expansions [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/817540/]Soul Harvest[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154040/]Fallen God[/url] will get you access to the complete PvP experience with all factions and the full story campaign.

If you love the PvP aspect of the game, we also offer the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1460150/]“SpellForce 3: Versus Edition - Full PvP Upgrade”[/url] DLC which contains the complete PvP experience with access to all 6 factions (Orcs, Humans, Elves, Dark Elves, Dwarves, Trolls).

[b]Please note that the full Single Player and story campaign experience is only unlocked by acquiring [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/311290/]SpellForce 3[/url] and its stand-alone expansions [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/817540/]Soul Harvest[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154040/]Fallen God[/url].[/b]

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Free PvP multiplayer
[*] Go for glory with Ranked and Unranked PVP matches
[*] Choose Skirmish mode to play against challenging AI opponents
[*] Battle against other human players of SpellForce 3, SpellForce 3: Soul Harvest, and SpellForce 3: Fallen God
[*] Play the single-player ‘Old Haalâyash’ scenario map
[/list]

[h2]SpellForce 3: Versus Edition - Full PvP Upgrade[/h2]
The “SpellForce 3: Versus Edition - Full PvP Upgrade” DLC contains the complete PvP experience with access to all 6 factions of the SpellForce 3 universe: Orcs, Humans, Elves, Dark Elves, Dwarves, Trolls.

[b]Please note that the full Single Player and story campaign experience is only unlocked by acquiring [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/311290/]SpellForce 3[/url] and its stand-alone expansions [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/817540/]Soul Harvest[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154040/]Fallen God[/url].[/b]

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Play all of the three base SpellForce 3 factions: Humans, Elves and Orcs
[*] Play the two Soul Harvest factions: Dwarves and Dark Elves
[*] Play the Troll faction from the Fallen God expansion
[*] Enjoy the full PvP multiplayer experience in Ranked, Unranked and AI matches
[*] Climb the leaderboard and the faction specific leaderboards to the top
[*] Challenge players from all other SpellForce 3 games: SpellForce 3, SpellForce 3: Soul Harvest and SpellForce 3: Fallen God
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: SpellForce 3 now available!
notes.content:
Dear SpellForce community,

[b]May The SpellForce Be With You![/b]
 
Munich, Germany/Vienna, Austria, December 7th 2017: The critically acclaimed RTS/RPG-series SpellForce returns today with a new installment: SpellForce 3 is available as a PC-exclusive title.

By combining real-time-strategy and role-playing, SpellForce 3 takes the best from both and blends it together in a unique way. Players will create their own hero, and meet others along their epic journey through the 30+ hours of campaign gameplay. They will construct large bases and muster powerful armies, command three different factions, clash together in multiplayer matches or join forces in the co-operative campaign.

The story of SpellForce 3 takes place before the events of its predecessors, telling the tale of the aftermath of the Mage Wars – an exciting experience for players of the former SpellForce games and players who are new to the franchise alike. In SpellForce 3’s launch trailer, you can see all the features that will #MakeRTSGreatAgain:

Watch the release trailer on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xPLUNEVZ4HQ

SpellForce 3 Steam page:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/311290/SpellForce_3/

If you are interested in, we are also offering the Digital Extras of SpellForce 3:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/732890/SpellForce_3_Digital_Extras/

See you on the battlefield!
Cheers
Your THQ Nordic Team

notes.title: SpellForce 3 gets a Free Preview Weekend on Steam
notes.content:
[b]Play the RTS/RPG hybrid ahead of its release in December | Multiplayer tournament announced during trial weekend[/b]

Munich/Vienna, November 17th 2017: The upcoming RTS/RPG hybrid SpellForce 3 will be playable for free on Steam from 10 AM PST November 17th, until 10 AM PST November 20th. 
Players can play all three factions of the game in multiplayer matches for up to six players, or try the co-op mode. Also, one single-player mission is playable alone or with a co-op partner, which takes place before the events in the full game’s campaign. 

You can find the free preview of SpellForce 3 here: 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/751610/SpellForce_3_Beta/ 

Watch the latest trailer on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bi_e_s4vgyA 

[b]Join The Tournament[/b]
During the free trial period, a SpellForce 3 tournament will be taking place with the chance to win a signed version of the limited Collector’s Edition or a Steam key of the game. You can earn points by playing (and winning) 1vs1 multiplayer matches – the players with the highest scores will win. You can find all the details on SpellForce 3’s official Facebook page: http://n.thq.com/73SI30gC8th

Stay tuned!
Your THQ Nordic Team

notes.title: New DLC Available - SpellForce 2 - Faith in Destiny Scenario 2: The Golden Fool
notes.content:
SpellForce 2 - Faith in Destiny Scenario 2: The Golden Fool , all new content for SpellForce 2: Faith in Destiny is Now Available on Steam.


For the first time in SpellForce, you play not as the hero to tell his story, but rather as one of the NPCs. The stories of the scenarios are set before Faith in Destiny and are briefly mentioned there. The scenarios pick up these discussions of their past and tell these stories in detail.

The Golden Fool

Ever since Amun Kar invented the game of stones Drakkar, there has been a legend of the golden fool, a stone that was created only once, and defeats every other stone. After Carla was defeated in Shadow Wars, she risks everything to find that stone to regain her reputation as Drakkar champion. The search begins in the Tuscari Desert, but she soon realizes that she isn't the only one looking for the fool. A bitter battle for the golden fool soon arises...

SpellForce 2 - Faith in Destiny Scenario 1: Flink's Secret Diary , all new content for SpellForce 2: Faith in Destiny is Now Available on Steam.


For the first time in SpellForce, you play not as the hero to tell his story, but rather as one of the NPCs. The stories of the scenarios are set before Faith in Destiny and are briefly mentioned there. The scenarios pick up these discussions of their past and tell these stories in detail.

Flink's Secret Diary

Order Master Matricus has recorded his secrets of fire magic in a Fire Ledger a powerful artifact. This compendium grants its owner the powers of fire magic. But the orcs have stolen it. Flink McWinter, a famous thief and scoundrel from the SpellForce universe, was hired by Matricus (or so he claims) to steal back the Fire Ledger. He quickly realizes that this will unfortunately not be an easy task, even for a master thief such as he...
